channel.muteDescription: Muted channels don't notify you, except when someone mentions you by name.

createChannel.voiceDescription: Voice channels support audio/video calls instead of text messages.

renameChannel.notAdmin: You don't have admin permissions for this group.

createGroup.slugDescription: Auto-generated from name. Letters, numbers, hyphens.
createGroup.textChannelDescription: Adds a #General text channel to the new group. You can always add channels later.
createGroup.voiceChannelDescription: Adds a Voice Chat channel to the new group. You can always add channels later.
createGroup.slugInvalid: Slug must contain at least one letter or number

renameGroup.notAdmin: You don't have admin permissions for this group.

leaveGroup.confirm: Are you sure you want to leave {{name}}?
leaveGroup.rejoinNotice: You will need a new invite to rejoin.

kickMember.rejoinNotice: They will need a new invite to rejoin.

invites.acceptFailed: Couldn't accept the invite. Try again.

joinByInvite.heading: Join a group
joinByInvite.blurb: Invite links let you join without an admin looking you up first.
joinByInvite.tokenDescription: Paste the link you were sent, or just the code.

inviteLinks.heading: Invite link
inviteLinks.blurb: Anyone with the link can join this group. They still need a Pollis account.
inviteLinks.copyNotice: Copy it now — this is the only time it can be shown.

notify.inviteBodyUnknown: You have been invited to a group

resetAlias.consequence: They'll show their main profile here again. They can set a new alias.

bots.intro: A bot is a member of this group that runs on a machine an admin controls, not on Pollis's servers. It can read every message it receives in this group and post into its channels.
bots.capReached: This group has {{count}} bots, the most it can have. Delete one to add another.
bots.adminOnly: Only this group's admins manage its bots.

pairing.commandLabel: Run this on the bot's machine
pairing.machineNotice: The bot runs on that machine and keeps its keys there. It can read everything it receives, so use a machine you control.

create.lead: Install pollis-bot on the machine that will run the bot, then run the command below there. It prints a code; type that code here.

addHost.lead: A second machine keeps {{bot}} running when one goes down. Install pollis-bot there and run the command below; it prints a code to type here. One of the bot's current hosts hands it the bot's keys.

detail.hostsDescription: The machines this bot runs on. Each one holds the bot's keys and can read what it receives.
detail.recoveryNote: If every host is lost, the bot can't be recovered: delete it and create a new one.
detail.revokeConsequence: That machine stops running the bot. Its other hosts keep it running.
detail.revokeLastConsequence: This is the bot's only host. Once it is revoked the bot can't be recovered: delete it and create a new one.
detail.deleteDescription: It leaves the group and stops running on every host.

delete.consequence: It leaves the group and stops running on every host. This can't be undone.

errors.codeMismatch: That code doesn't match. Read it again off the bot's machine and type it in.
errors.capReached: This group already has the most bots it can have. Delete one to add another.
errors.requestExpired: That code has expired. Run the command again for a new one.

app.noApp: Its host hasn't offered an App yet. Start the bot with an App and it shows up here.

reasons.not_approved: No App has been approved for it yet.
reasons.hash_mismatch: Its host runs a build you haven't approved.
reasons.developer_key_mismatch: Its build is signed by a developer key you haven't approved.
reasons.build_widens: Its new build asks for more than you approved.
reasons.wrong_kind: Its approval is of the wrong kind.
reasons.wrong_installation: Its approval was made for a different bot.
reasons.approver_not_in_group: The admin who approved it is no longer in this group.
reasons.uncertified_approver: The device that approved it couldn't be confirmed as an admin's.
reasons.bad_signature: Its approval's signature doesn't check out.
reasons.transparency_alarm: The approving admin's keys don't match the public key log.
reasons.not_admin: It was approved by someone who isn't an admin of this group.
reasons.manifest_mismatch: Its App doesn't match the one that was approved.
reasons.widened_grants: Its approval grants more than the App asks for.
reasons.rolled_back: An older approval was put back in place of a newer one.
reasons.bad_build_signature: Its build's developer signature doesn't check out.
reasons.artifact_unavailable: Its host couldn't load the App.

marks.noEgress: Can't send data outside this group

lines.reads: Reads {{events}} in {{channels}}, and history from the last {{history}}
lines.keeps: Keeps up to {{size}} of its own data

grants.heading: Access
grants.description: Take away what it doesn't need. It never gets more than its App asks for.
grants.noChannels: This group has no channel it asks for.
grants.history: Days of history it may read (0 to {{max}})
grants.egress: Hosts it may send data to

pending.firstLead: The bot's host offers this App. Nothing runs until an admin approves it.
pending.updateLead: Its host offers a new build. Look at what changed before you approve it.
pending.neededHint: Allow each new access marked as needed to approve this update.
pending.developmentHint: Runs any build signed by this developer key that doesn't ask for more than you approved.
pending.developmentUnavailable: Start pollis app dev to offer a developer key.
pending.autoUpdateHint: Updates from the same source that ask for nothing new approve themselves.

errors.stale: Another admin approved this bot just now. Look again before you approve.
errors.changed: The App changed since this page opened. Look again before you approve.
